title: Inconsistent Categorical Encoding
description: Detection of divergent textual representations, case mismatches, leading/trailing whitespace, and semantic synonyms.
conditions: Categorical feature displays unexpectedly high cardinality
Free-text or manually entered strings present in operational databases
recommended_methods: String normalization (trimming whitespace, case collapsing to lowercase)
Edit distance clustering (Levenshtein / Token Sort Ratio) for typo detection
selection_rules: Always apply whitespace trimming and lowercasing as an initial baseline
If similarity to an approved canonical dictionary term > 0.85, auto-map to canonical term
If string cannot be resolved unambiguously, flag for manual domain review
limitations: Aggressive fuzzy mapping may collapse distinct medical or clinical terms (e.g., Stage IIA vs Stage IIB)
Lookup dictionaries require regular synchronization with domain ontologies
